WITH FemaleClients AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id, 
        AVG(d.A11) AS avg_salary
    FROM 
        client c
    JOIN 
        disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE 
        c.gender = 'F'
    GROUP BY 
        c.client_id
),
OldestClient AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(birth_date) AS min_birth_date
    FROM 
        client
),
LowestSalaryGap AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(avg_salary) - MIN(avg_salary) AS gap
    FROM 
        FemaleClients
)
SELECT 
    fc.client_id AS account_number,
    lsg.gap
FROM 
    FemaleClients fc
JOIN 
    OldestClient oc ON fc.birth_date = oc.min_birth_date
CROSS JOIN 
    LowestSalaryGap lsg;
